plugins.name: agnes-media
plugins.description: Image & video generation for ZCode: text-to-image, image-to-image, image editing, multi-image composition, text-to-video / keyframe / reference video. No built-in credentials — run /agnes-media:init once after install to configure your own API key & base URL; provider presets for Agnes and OpenAI-compatible gateways; candidate chains (up to 3) fail over across vendors atomically; model fallback chains (up to 3) switch on 429/5xx/timeout/unreachable; optional prompt enhancement. MCP tools: generate_image, edit_image, generate_video, video_status, media_config, configure_media.

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: 影匠 · 图片视频生成

description_i18n.en: Image & video generation: text-to-image, image-to-image, image editing, multi-image composition, text-to-video / keyframe / reference video. No built-in credentials; configure your own key & base URL. Provider presets (Agnes / OpenAI-compatible / custom), candidate chains for cross-vendor failover, model fallback chains (max 3, optional 2nd/3rd), optional prompt enhancement.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 文生图、图生图、图片编辑、多图合成、文生视频/关键帧/参考视频。图片与视频可分别配置不同厂商（各用各的 Base URL/Key/模型）；接口格式按地址自动判断；/agnes-media:init 交互式初始化；模型兜底链 + 跨厂商候选链；可选提示词增强。无内置默认凭据。
